description: Dark red floor-length fitted overdress over cream linen underdress, low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold geometric trim at neckline, cuffs, waist and central skirt panel. Cream fringed shawl with patterned red/gold borders rests around forearms, decorated belt with circular fittings, pendant, earrings and rings, gold-brown leather shoe visible through low front walking opening. Both hands visible. No headgear, armor or weapon; other foot beneath opaque skirt.
